title: Burns Philp Building, Normanton
geometryBasis: The mapped roof footprint determines the building scale and the lateral position of the covered street edges. The statutory description distinguishes the three parallel bays and the Landsborough Street facade.
sectionBasis: Queensland Heritage Register entry 602781 specifies the raised floor, roof valleys, central ridge ventilators, window and door stations. The original photograph provides the three decorated parapet curves and profile of the projecting street awnings.
limitations: Exterior elevation heights, colors and some openings are approximated from the archived street photograph and published description.
The detached strong room and the current information centre interior are outside the model scope.
